Results.ReviewText: Works great. Wheels are a bit too small though, so it doesn't roll very well unless floor is very smooth
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Quality grill, second one I have owned long life easy to use and service
Results.Title: Quality grill

Results.ReviewText:
Good:  The grill itself is great with flop down shelves and sleek overall design.  Burner knobs and lighter respond quickly.  
Bad:  The wheel locks are hard to access with your foot.  
Ugly:  This issue is not about any visual presentation of the unit.  It is the placement of the propane tank in the cabinet.  My big complaint is the installation of the propane tank.  What would be seemingly an easy concept of placing the tank inside the cabinet and securing with a simple restraining system does not exist.  Rather the engineers and designers thought a system of hanging the tank on a weight hook that visually shows how much propane gas is left in the tank would be a great idea.  So what is the problem with such a clever idea?  Lifting a full propane tank onto the "hook" is nearly impossible unless you are an avid weight lifter or you can get the assistance of another person who can help you lift the tank from the back open side of the cabinet.  Normally we lift heavy objects with our body (torso) over and above the object.  In the case of placing the tank on the weight hook, the body of the solo lifter is in front of the cabinet with only their arms are inside the cabinet.  This arrangement is extremely difficult to do and bad for the back for one person to accomplish.  What makes it even more challenging is the existence of a large round hole in the floor of the cabinet just under the final placement of the tank.  The hole is large enough that the tank slips right through the hole during the attempt to place the tank on the hook.  So what is the purpose of the hole?  It allows the full tank to hang past the cabinet floor.  This hanging system is the ugly part of this grill when the existence of a tank gauge would be a better system of letting the owner know how much gas is still in the tank.
Results.Title: Mixed review:  Good, Bad, and Ugly

Results.ReviewText: Ordered wrong part, burner assembly. Called them to fix that and found out my grill was still under warranty (10 years). Gave me a credit on wrong part AND sent correct part no charge.
Results.Title: Hard to beat…grill and service

Results.ReviewText:
Since 2002 I’ve had the pleasure of grilling on Weber grills.  This is my third Spirit E-210 Gas Grill.
I appreciate Weber’s innovation over the years - and their commitment to quality components. I’m a “heavy user,” in that I use the grill four or five nights a week. It’s not usual for me to shovel a path through the snow to the grill in the winter. I have to confess my observations and experiences with Weber are overwhelmingly positive.  The rare issues I’ve had with my Weber grills have been external to the product.  The time when squirrels chewed on the rubber gas line, corrosive ocean-salt air, losing a part when moving from one house to another . . .All resolved with help from Weber’s excellent Customer Care representatives.  One last data point to consider when deciding a brand of grill: Weber’s Warranty.  In all my years of using my Weber grills I had an issue with a flavor bar.  The grill was still under warranty and the Customer Care representative sent a replacement. Easy.
In my opinion, Weber honors the values of integrity, quality and customer satisfaction.
Results.Title: Just Keeps Getting Better

Results.ReviewText:
After researching  a lot, I chose this E-210 LP gas  grill , 1st because of Weber's warranty and reputation. 2ndly because it had fold down shelves. I've got a smaller deck and wanted a smaller footprint. The size is still big enough for a decent amount of grilling space. It's easy to fold the side shelves up or down and with a good cover and with shelves folded it tucks away nicely in the corner. It ignites immediately, heats up fast and seems to grill evenly. For the limited time used it did a great job on burgers and steaks. Longer usage on different foods is to be determined.  I had it assembled and delivered, with old grill hauled away for free so no hassles there.
The one glaring problem is there is only a short back panel on the back leaving a large opening. This allows wind to blow in, looks unfinished, and because we get critters, they probably will crawl into the grill. My dealer is ordering a second panel to install which should mostly eliminate that problem. It's a strange cost cutting decision because Weber's other grills have a full back panel.
All in all, for the cost and performance this is a great smaller grill choice and recommended. We'll see if it lasts as long as my old 35 year old grill.
Results.Title: First new BBQ grill in 35 years

Results.ReviewText: The sparker should start the grill with either burner selected. This is really a very potential dangerous condition. We love the the grill. It's  made very well. We're surprised that the sparker only goes to the left burner. We have had many grills in our live. We have never had one that only sparked one burner. Why did you do this? Our only guess, is cost reduction. Minimally, you should of had a label on the panel alerting the use of the left burner for lighting. I know it's on the inside of the door, that's just not good enough.
Results.Title: Insufficient sparker

Results.ReviewText: The Spirit E-210 propane grill is an excellent product. We have Genisis at our San Diego home and I noticed that Weber has enhanced it's products with designed burner covers, folding shelf extensions and other features. Also, we like the fact that we can add a flat top to the grill to cook other food like pancakes, eggs, etc. This is a very nice feature.
Results.Title: Spirit E-210 - Great Product!

Results.ReviewText: Wow, is all I can say about this grill.  It’s perfect for me myself and I and occasionally some friends. The salesman at Ace Hardware told me everything I needed to know before I purchased this grill.  It’s small so it doesn’t take up a lot of space on my deck. It heats up very fast. For a small two burner gas grill it really cooks. High temperatures are there if you need them. It’s easy to clean. It looks way more expensive than it was. It’s very well made.  The Weber name says it all. My previous grill was a genesis Weber that I had so long the bottom fell out. This is a great replacement. I love it and would highly recommend it. Asked for the griddle for my birthday. Fingers crossed!  No regrets on this purchase at all.
Results.Title: Well made grill in’ machine!

Results.ReviewText: Sturdy, good materials, easy to light and clean. Like having sides pull down to save patio space. Rollers move smoothly on the floor. Good buy!
Results.Title: Quality Grill

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill its the perfect size and its slides that fold down make it easy storage . It has a gas meter that works ok. And its all pretty well built.
Results.Title: My E-210

Results.ReviewText: My new Spirit E210 is perfect for me except for one problem…I’m a 75 year old woman, I can’t lift the gas tank onto the hook inside the cabinet. I wish I had bought the other model that doesn’t have a cabinet for the gas tank.
Results.Title: Love it…one problem

Results.ReviewText: My first Weber. Tired of replacing lesser quality grills and shopping for replacement parts to keep them running. As a middle aged couple whose kids have grown and have their own families, the Spirit E-210 looked like the perfect size for us. After reading reviews and doing my research I made the decision to make the purchase. Amazon Prime Day had a good price and the assembly was free so it was super easy. I am so happy. I’ve always been the cook of the family and appreciate nice tools and appliances. I wish I had done this a long time ago. Everything you could want and Weber app offers tips, tricks and recipes. I’m happy to be a member of the Weber family.
Results.Title: I’ll Never Use Anything Else

Results.ReviewText: We decided to downsize from a 4-burner to a 2-burner grill.  Being seniors, this is the perfect size for the two of us.  It’s small enough for me to handle without any problems.  We’ve cooked everything from hotdogs to steaks.  While Weber grills run higher in price than other brands, you get what you pay for.  Hopefully this will be our last grill.
Results.Title: Perfect Size For Seniors

Results.ReviewText: I am disappointed with grill because the back of the grate gets much hotter than the front of the grate.
Results.Title: Uneven heating

Results.ReviewText: Nice little grill. Fits in the space we wanted it for. Could use a 3rd burner to get enough heat to blacken fish.
Results.Title: Good quality grill, doesn't burn very hot

Results.ReviewText: I have had Webers all my life. Have recently gone from charcoal to propane.
Results.Title: New Weber Spirit

Results.ReviewText: What I like the most about this grill is ease of clean up.  The way grease makes its way to the collection tray is nice.  I would recommend the available grill pans to capture most of the grease.  I also enjoy the sturdiness of the grill.  The caster wheels are heavy duty.  I am really happy with this grill.
Results.Title: Quality product.

Results.ReviewText: It's exactly what we wanted. A smaller grill but still has everything we need.
Results.Title: Perfect grill for us

Results.ReviewText: Not a true fan. The heating isn't my favorite. I do not like that the whole back is lit even when you only want one side. Its wastes gas. Do not see what the hype is about.
Results.Title: Weber

Results.ReviewText: Love everything about the grill except, replaced the plastic casters with ones that will stand up to being outside all year-round for many years.
Results.Title: Great grill....so so casters

Results.ReviewText: I just received a replacement part for my grill which is 10 years old.  I love the grill, use it all the time, year round.  The gas burner needed to be replaced and thankfully for the Weber warranty the burner element was covered
Results.Title: New burner

Results.ReviewText: I just love the new grill. It works great and heats up quickly. It’s easy to clean and is just the perfect size.
Results.Title: Perfect Grill

Results.ReviewText: Like the grill so far but do not grill much as I am a single person.  Bought your brand due to recommendation of my nephew who has purchased two grills.  Like that your stand behind your product with a good warranty.
Results.Title: Good Product by a company that stands behind it.

Results.ReviewText: I am happy my product is very good. I use many time about 3 or 4 time by week
I've got 4 gas tanks and only one of them will seal with your connection. Surely other people have had this problem also. I need a solution.
Results.Title: Gas Leak at connection to the bottle.

Results.ReviewText: We bought this several years ago. At first we were happy with it. However over time -not speaking about a long time- we had to replace several parts, like the drip/catch pan, the 3 heat deflectors (?) , the original cover for the E 210 is not available anymore, (the first cover fit perfectly and was made w/qualitative good material, and was cheaper as it had to cover only a closed grill.  The good side of this grill, it has metal siding and the door in the front (no creatures can get into the cabinet), grilling makes fun with this grill. One last comment to the tiny wheels below, they just crack and fall off in pieces over time. :-(.
Results.Title: Good and not so good features.

Results.ReviewText: Have not used grill yet, confident it will work well.
Results.Title: still waiting to use it

Results.ReviewText: I always have been a buy cheap and then replace when trashed grill person. There is no difference.  Gas is Gas. Whatever.  I WAS WRONG. This little grill seriously cooks BETTER than ANY cheapo I have ever purchased.  My food is EVEN. Sear marks are perfect. Heats up like a volcano. The design saves time with clean up. Even has a simple spring gas reader that helps take out tank fill guesswork. Saves space with fold down shelves.  Very happy with my purchase.
Results.Title: Believe the Hype
A good grill...2 things could be better

Results.ReviewText:
The warming tray does not fit into the slots in the cookbox.  Weber sent a replacement and the replacement warming tray does not fit either.  So, they sent a new cookbox - what am I supposed to do with that???? 
Customer service had me on the phone for over an hour (2nd time) and I sent many many pictures of the problem.  So, here I am 6 weeks later with a useless extra cookbox and no warming tray which is what I need.
Results.Title: Parts don't fit and customer service is horrible

Results.ReviewText: My wife and I have always had Weber.  Charocal first, then gas.  Decided to downsize 4-5 years ago and bought the Spirit 210.  We used it often.  Unfortunately leaving a grill outside our back patio in Florida eventually took it's toll.  Burners eventually gave way, front door rusted off, and the frame of the grill around the base doing the same.  Not angry, we got a tremendous amount of use out of it and are shopping for another as we speak.
Results.Title: Great Grill for Empty Nesters

Results.ReviewText: Excellent performance and support from Weber! Can't say enough good things!
Results.Title: Outstanding customer support!

Results.ReviewText:
This is our third or fourth Weber grill, and from a design standpoint it is clearly the best. The burner arrangement (side by side) facilitates indirect cooking. 
However, I have one quality issue: the side tables are showing signs of rust spots. This is not tru of the metal on the control faceplates, just the fold-up side surfaces. This is concerning since the grill is only a month or so old, and rust will definitely get worse in time.
Results.Title: Improved design

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill. Love the ease of cleaning, heavy duty grates, removable grease tray, even heating, & keeps the heat in well. This little grill is perfect size for our family of 4.
Results.Title: Excellent grill.

Results.ReviewText: I purchased my grill over a month ago and haven't been able to use it due to a gas leak that so far hasn't been resolved. At this point I doubt I would ever buy another Weber Product.
Results.Title: Disatisfied

Results.ReviewText: Love it. Fist time grill owner and love it. Using it more than I ever expected.
Results.Title: Great grill, fast meals

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
